verdict.rationale: Unit describes itself as a platform companies build on 'using APIs and components'. Its APIs expose customer, account, payment, card, transaction and compliance data, and it publishes API docs (an 'Explore the API' entry point and a /docs/api/ section including webhook events) plus an llms.txt. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found (all probed paths 404, docs markdown 404), no evidence detailing endpoints, authentication or SDKs, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
